products.short_description: Elegant Lacoste Slim Fit shirt crafted from premium cotton pinpoint with a button-down collar and genuine mother-of-pearl buttons.
products.long_description: The Lacoste Men's Slim Fit Shirt (CH1843HBP) is an elegant formal tailored piece made from premium cotton pinpoint—a fabric that sits perfectly between a fine poplin and a sturdy Oxford. The texture evokes the iconic Lacoste piqué feel while maintaining a crisp, formal look. It features a sophisticated button-down collar, a slim-fit cut for a modern silhouette, and authentic mother-of-pearl buttons. Finished with the signature small embroidered green crocodile on the chest, it is a versatile best-seller ideal for both business and smart-casual occasions.
